verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any reporting or analytics capability that shows dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, or review workload, and it documents no export of such metrics. Marketing claims such as "Approve more and decline fewer legit orders" and "Drop time spent on manual review up to 80%" describe outcomes, not a metrics view. The sandbox doc names console views (Explore, Queues, Workflows) only in passing, with no KPI reporting or board-ready export described.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
